title: node-saved
description: A node's revision saved in the working copy; a second writer stopped, with both versions; or why not.

conflict.description: The file changed since it was opened: nothing is written.

opened.description: The SHA-256 of the file as it now is: what the next save is held to.

findings.description: What its content still lacks, by the release checks; saving does not wait on them.

writer.description: On a conflict, who wrote the file as it now is.

theirs.description: On a conflict, the file as it now is, as base64.

yours.description: On a conflict, the edit sent, as base64.
